traceability.notes: All functional acceptance criteria from `docs/stories/022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE.story.md` are met:,- **Before Other Tags / After Other Tags / Mixed Positions**: Covered by three dedicated valid tests using JSDoc blocks with traceability annotations before, after, and interleaved with `@param`/`@returns` tags.,- **Proper Termination / JSDoc Tag Detection / Continuation Lines**: Implemented via `isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine` and the new early-return branch in `processCommentLine`, ensuring any JSDoc `@tag` line (other than @story/@req/@supports) finalizes the current pending traceability value and is not concatenated into it; only non-`@` lines are treated as continuations.,- **Error Messages / No False Positives**: The previous bug (requirement IDs being polluted by following JSDoc tags) is directly regression-tested in `[REQ-NO-FALSE-POSITIVES] JSDoc tags do not pollute requirement ID when following @req`. Because that test passes and invalid-format tests still behave as expected, the parser now only reports errors for real format issues.,- **Backward Compatible**: All pre-existing annotation-format tests (multi-line paths, multi-line reqs, configurable patterns, @supports behavior, etc.) continue to pass, demonstrating no regression in earlier behavior.,- **Documentation**: The `valid-annotation-format` rule docs have been updated with a dedicated "JSDoc coexistence" section and concrete examples showing traceability annotations correctly coexisting with `@param` and `@returns` tags.,- **Tests**: Multiple new tests in `tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts` explicitly reference this story and all of its new requirements via `@req` IDs and descriptive test names.,Given this evidence, Story 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE is fully implemented and verified.
